# odinex_load_balancer (Resource)

Manages a load balancer with its services and targets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "odinex_load_balancer" "web" {
  name               = "web"
  load_balancer_type = "lb11"
  location           = "fra1"

  # Reach server targets on their private address (needed for servers
  # without public IPs).
  network_id = odinex_network.private.id

  algorithm {
    type = "least_connections"
  }

  service {
    protocol    = "http"
    listen_port = 80
    health_check {
      protocol = "http"
      port     = 80
      http {
        path = "/healthz"
      }
    }
  }

  target {
    type           = "label_selector"
    label_selector = "role=web"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `load_balancer_type` (String) Type of the load balancer, e.g. `lb11`. Can be changed in place.
- `location` (String) Location, e.g. `fra1`. Changing it recreates the load balancer.
- `name` (String) Name of the load balancer.

### Optional

- `algorithm` (Block, Optional) Load balancing algorithm. Defaults to `round_robin`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--algorithm))
- `delete_protection` (Boolean) Prevent the resource from being deleted. Defaults to `false`.
- `labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels (key/value pairs). Up to 64 pairs; keys and values up to 63 characters.
- `network_id` (Number) ID of a private network to reach server targets in: servers attached to it are reached on their private address (servers without public IPs only this way). The public addresses of the load balancer do not change. Changed in place.
- `service` (Block List) A service (listener). All services are replaced in one call when any of them changes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service))
- `target` (Block Set) A target: a server, a label selector or an IP. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--target))
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique ID of the resource.
- `ipv4` (String) Public IPv4 address.
- `ipv6` (String) Public IPv6 address.
- `status` (String) Status of the load balancer.

<a id="nestedblock--algorithm"></a>
### Nested Schema for `algorithm`

Optional:

- `type` (String) `round_robin` (default) or `least_connections`.


<a id="nestedblock--service"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service`

Required:

- `listen_port` (Number) Port the load balancer listens on.
- `protocol` (String) `tcp` or `http`.

Optional:

- `destination_port` (Number) Port of the targets; defaults to `listen_port`.
- `health_check` (Block, Optional) Health check of the targets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service--health_check))
- `http` (Block, Optional) HTTP options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service--http))
- `proxyprotocol` (Boolean) Enable the PROXY protocol.

<a id="nestedblock--service--health_check"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service.health_check`

Optional:

- `http` (Block, Optional) HTTP health check options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service--health_check--http))
- `interval` (Number) Seconds between checks (default 15).
- `port` (Number) Port to check.
- `protocol` (String) `tcp` or `http`.
- `retries` (Number) Failed checks before a target is unhealthy (default 3).
- `timeout` (Number) Timeout in seconds (default 10).

<a id="nestedblock--service--health_check--http"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service.health_check.http`

Optional:

- `path` (String) Request path.
- `status_codes` (List of String) Accepted status codes, e.g. `["2??", "3??"]`.



<a id="nestedblock--service--http"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service.http`

Optional:

- `sticky_sessions` (Boolean) Enable sticky sessions.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell

```
